## Checks

Please run these before you open the pull request, as in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md):

```bash
pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
```

- [ ] `pnpm lint`
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] `pnpm test`
- [ ] `pnpm build`

## Promises this change keeps

- [ ] Nothing is saved or sent outside the person's computer and their chosen model.
- [ ] No new network call of the app's own, or it is off until the person turns it on and the screen says what it does.
- [ ] No key reaches the page, an address, a log or an error.
- [ ] Anything that reaches outside goes through the approval gate.
- [ ] No new dependency, or the reason is written above.
- [ ] The work is my own, or its source and licence are named above.
- [ ] I agree to the contribution terms in CONTRIBUTING.md, and added myself to CONTRIBUTORS.md.

The product name is OpenStellarFirm. The repository name stays
`worker-bot-open-source`.
